description: This file defines the internal class 'PeriodicAction' used for executing an action periodically based on a specified time interval.

classes.name: PeriodicAction
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a periodic action, executing a specified action at regular time intervals.

methods.name: PeriodicAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the periodic action with a specified interval, action, and optional start time.

methods.name: TryAction
methods.description: Attempts to execute the action if the current time has reached or passed the next scheduled execution time.
